limits: RTL-level bench of the routed module source, not a gate-level simulation of the routed netlist

the tiles are pure one-flop relays: they hold no credit counter, no valid/ready and no address decode; back-pressure, credits and station addressing are driven by the bench END POINTS through the tile, and no tile has a station ADD path
one-way tiles (rwa, rwb): the credit return does not cross the tile (one-flop bench wire), so the CREDIT mutant does not apply
mechanics only: production throughput of the VM8 control plane is a separate gate and stays OPEN
